title: samesight-verify --json report
description: The one document samesight-verify --json writes to stdout, for exits 0, 1 and 2.

$schema.description: Where this schema is published, for the version that wrote the document.

version.description: The document's format version; a change that breaks readers raises it.

result.description: The exit code in a word: 0 passed, 1 failed, 2 incomplete.

exitCode.description: 0 when nothing failed, 1 when a check found something, 2 when the run could not do its job.

replay.description: The command that replays the differential's failure, when it failed.

sections.description: The sections the run printed, in order, with their findings.

error.description: Why the run could not run: a bad flag, a missing file, a database it could not reach.

detail.description: The finding as the text output says it, row reports included.

incomplete.description: A fail that says the check could not run, not that it found something.

RowReport.description: One row a user's device and RLS disagree on.

kind.description: leak: the device has a row RLS refuses; hidden: a column the policy hides; gap: RLS lets them read a row no stream sent; unsent: a column missing from a sent row; differs: a copy unlike the database's.

row.description: The row as the run describes it: its table, id, tenant and the users and values it holds.

query.description: The query's label in the config, such as queries[0].

policies.description: For a leak or a gap: the user's RLS read policies on the table, each evaluated on the row.

policiesNote.description: Why the policies were not evaluated, or what they say together.

fix.description: For a leak the narrow rule covers: what to add to which query, checked against the row.

add.description: The clause to add, such as WHERE owner_id = auth.user_id().
